notes.title: Update Notes for 2023 June 27
notes.content:
According to the feedbacks, make an update.
[list]
[*]Added 2 more new puzzles!!!
[*]Polish the game by delete some duplicated 3D models in scenes.
[*]AISister walks faster now. And you can skip walking process to next level.
[*]Disable levels achievements.
[*]Adjust objects' scale.
[/list]
Stay tune. We planned to update and add new puzzle into the game every week!

notes.title: DotDot Early Access Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240458/ec85c8e8805388bcc8a9949c32e820da794961ed.jpg[/img]
[h3]About[/h3]
Puzzles, octagons, dark, rain, cat, glass marbles, silky hair, rooms...
Point and click.

[h3]Early Access[/h3]
We want to hear the feedbacks from gamers, so we can make changes and improve the game. Half of the contents are done and published right now. Estimate to release version 1.0 in late 2023 or early 2024.

[h3]Dev's Whisper[/h3]
I fxxked up.

It is not easy to become an indie game dev. I was thinking oppositely until a day before DotDot release.

It take times to make a game, when only 2 men are working on it. My partner is learning C# while writing scripts for the games, because he never learn how to program. We blame Unity everyday, most of the time we fight with it, up to 31 days with 0 progress may happened. Back and forward, reverse and forward. This is like working, the process is as painful as your jobs, the main difference is no one pay us any salary in the process, and we have to tell everyone we are umemployee. This is fine, I am not fxxked up yet.

Then we put our first project(2D pixel art TD game) on hold. Reason? It just pure pain. After we working a year on it, everything mess up. This is a prectidable result, we are rookie, but we expect too much of ourselves. Fine. We decided to make a simpler game - DotDot.

Steam tell us to promote the game before it released. I did. I lied. Actually I did not. Every video game journalism or media platform I contacted, either they are big or small, ignore or gave a perfunctory answer to my request to review DotDot. I don't know the reason, maybe I am simply just unlucky, or they read their email annually. One of the platform did answer me, he asked for (CNY)26k to promote anything, I thought he was joking so I escaped. Until now, I registered my game on IndieDB, thanks a lot.

39, to everyone who supports me, 39!

At least I am not totally fxxked up, yet.
